need.current_gap: CMS persistence exists, but Volvence lacks decisive evidence for when relationship observations should become durable memory, when compression loses exact facts, and when writes create stale, conflicting, non-consensual, or identity-level pollution.
falsification_criteria: Naive full recent context or retrieval-only memory matches or outperforms gated CMS under equal context, latency, and token budgets.
Compressed memory loses exact facts, conflict correction, deletion semantics, consent scope, or unrelated-task locality.
Any write eligibility decision depends on evaluator, judge, human score, keywords, or an unowned reconstructed hidden state.
protected_boundaries: This Demand remains NEEDS_TASK_DESIGN and may become concurrently eligible with substrate work only after the readout study has a named-human PROCEED outcome.
Memory writes must use the vz-memory owner API and frozen immutable snapshots; no consumer may create a second owner.
Evaluation and human anchors validate outcomes only and cannot become the learning source.
need.required_outcome: Freeze stateless, full recent context, retrieval-only, gated CMS, and gated CMS plus bounded steering arms over cross-session exact, semantic, procedural, preference, conflict, correction, deletion, and restore episodes.
success_criteria: The gated write policy improves preregistered cross-session behavioral outcomes over stateless, naive full-context, retrieval-only, and ungated-memory controls.
Eligible writes derive only from owner snapshots and PE downstream credit with exact source, consent, conflict, deletion, and policy lineage.
Checkpoint, deletion, restore, conflict update, locality, stale-memory recovery, and rollback drills all pass.

objective: Determine whether a PE/credit-bounded relationship-memory write policy improves cross-session behavior over stateless, full-recent-context, retrieval-only, and ungated-memory baselines while preserving conflict correction, deletion, consent, locality, and rollback.
title: Establish when relationship memory writes help rather than pollute
